# CLAUDE.md — Subscriptions Module

Scope: guidance for `vendor/corals/subscriptions` only. This is the standalone Composer package `corals/subscriptions`, installed here as a **vendor package** (moved from the old dynamic-module location `Corals/modules/Subscriptions`). Do not treat instructions in the root project `CLAUDE.md` about `Corals/modules/*` as applying to this folder — this module now follows the vendor-package pattern used by `corals/cms`, `corals/payment`, etc.

## What this module is

`code: corals-subscriptions`, namespace `Corals\Modules\Subscriptions`, provider `Corals\Modules\Subscriptions\SubscriptionsServiceProvider`. Manages subscription plans, products, features, usage, and billing cycles. Depends on (per `composer.json`): `corals/payment`, `corals/cms`. It is itself a dependency of `corals/marketplace` (`supported_platforms: [Marketplace, Classified]` in `module.json`).

## Autoloading note

`corals/subscriptions` is **not** a proper Composer dependency of the root project (its packages.laraship.com license is expired, so `composer require`/`update` for it will fail). Instead, its PSR-4 namespace is wired directly into the root project's own `composer.json` `autoload.psr-4`:

```json
"Corals\\Modules\\Subscriptions\\": "vendor/corals/subscriptions/src"
```

This is regenerated by a plain `composer dump-autoload` (fully offline — no repository contact, no license check). `SubscriptionsServiceProvider` is not Laravel-package-auto-discovered (it isn't in `vendor/composer/installed.json`), so it only loads through the DB-driven `Corals\Modules\ModulesServiceProvider` once the `modules` table row for `corals-subscriptions` is `enabled=1, installed=1`. That row has been seeded (via `Modules::getModulesSettings()`), currently sitting at `enabled=0, installed=0` — same "discovered but not installed" state as `corals-cms`, `corals-payment`, etc. in this environment. Install/enable it the normal way: Settings → Modules in the admin UI, or `php artisan corals:modules --action=install --type=module --module_name=corals-subscriptions`. Install Subscriptions before Marketplace (`load_order` 600 vs 601, and Marketplace requires it).

If `vendor/corals/subscriptions` is ever moved or replaced, re-run `composer dump-autoload` — no other step is needed for autoloading to pick it up.

## Structure

- `src/SubscriptionsServiceProvider.php` — extends `Corals\Foundation\Providers\BasePackageServiceProvider`. `registerPackage()` runs only if the `modules` DB row for `corals-subscriptions` is `enabled=1, installed=1`; `bootPackage()` same gate. `registerModulesPackages()` always runs on boot and calls `Modules::addModulesPackages('corals/subscriptions')` so the Settings module manager can locate `module.json` under `vendor/corals/subscriptions`.
- `src/Providers/` — `SubscriptionsRouteServiceProvider`, `SubscriptionsAuthServiceProvider`, `SubscriptionsObserverServiceProvider`, `UpdateModuleServiceProvider` (registered from `registerPackage()` / run during module update).
- `src/Models/` — `Product`, `Plan`, `Feature`, `FeatureModel`, `PlanUsage`, `Subscription`, `SubscriptionCycle`.
- `src/Http/Controllers/` — `SubscriptionsController`, `ProductsController`, `PlansController`, `FeaturesController`, `SubscriptionCyclesController`, `PlanUsageController`.
- `src/Facades/` — `SubscriptionProducts`, `UsageManager`, `SubscriptionsManager` (aliased in `registerPackage()`'s `booted()` callback, not via `config/app.php`).
- `src/Hooks/` — `Billing` (mixed into `Corals\User\Models\User`), `Subscribable` (mixed into `Corals\Modules\CMS\Models\Category`), `Subscription`.
- `src/Widgets/` — shortcode widgets (`subscriptions`, `plans`, `subscription_ratio`, `features_usage_statistics`).
- `src/Events/` `SubscriptionCreated`, listened to by `src/Listeners/HandleSubscriptionCreated`; also listens to `Corals\Modules\Payment\Common\Events\InvoicePaidEvent` via `InvoicePaidListener`.
- `src/routes/web.php` — routes for `subscriptions`, `products`, `products.plans`, `products.features`, `subscription-cycles`, `plan-usage`; gated in part by `SubscriptionMiddleware` / `CanSubscripeMiddleware`.
- `src/config/subscriptions.php` — merged config.
- `src/database/` — migrations/seeders; `src/update-batches/` — versioned upgrade scripts (`1.1.1.php` ... `10.0.2.php`) run by `Modules::executeModuleBatches()`.
- `src/Console/Commands/SubscriptionCheckup.php`.

## Working in this module

- Follow `corals/subscriptions`'s own `composer.json` (PSR-4 `Corals\Modules\Subscriptions\` → `src`) — do not add a second autoload entry in the root project for this namespace.
- Version/require changes belong in `vendor/corals/subscriptions/composer.json`, not the root project's.
- `module.json` (`folder: Subscriptions`, `load_order: 600`) drives the Settings module manager's install/enable/disable/update UI — it is unrelated to Composer's own package resolution, just to the in-app "Modules" admin screen. Note `load_order: 600` is lower than Marketplace's `601`, so Subscriptions is expected to load first.
